scope: Independent source and analytic review. Smooth common radial multiplier across every original partner frequency window including the re-expressed direct part, at fixed actual live allocation. Fixed additional divisibility or avoidance ideal independent of grouped h0; no arbitrary sharp-window selection.
checks: The original primal-zero predicate is X/(EJ)>1/2 on the fixed dyad and allocation. Re-expressing the direct part leaves each live allocation with one complete frequency sum, since the original low, middle and far windows partition it when the direct test fails. The same smooth multiplier is used on the whole sum before the separate middle subtraction. No previously discarded primal-zero allocation is restored by inverse Poisson.

For v dividing the actual frequency, the physical reindexing k=v k' changes the Poisson scale from L to LV and the band from T to T/V. Their product is invariant. The primitive prefactor ratio is 1/V, and the fixed raw factor conjugate(psi_u(v)) retains its zeros. Schwartz extension is allowed by truncation. Fixed avoidance uses the finite squarefree divisor expansion.

After radial scaling, X depends on q but not z, and at most two q derivatives produce X-degree at most two. Three eta Laplacians use C^6 selector derivatives and give (1+X^2)^-3; the q polynomial loses at most one factor. Fixed physical support of W gives all needed Fourier derivatives on the compact frequency range. Two compact log integrations in each variable give the stated L1 majorant.

The L twist separates through its exact two cutoff norms. The original J step remains an independent exact integer product predicate, and the new primal ideal enters only through fixed contractions and the summable p/V mass. The h0-allocation dependence of sigma stays a signed coefficient after division by the common pointwise majorant. Fixed v is necessary for this construction.

The joint positive moment still groups h0^2 b_s on actual good squarefree factors, with original conjugation untouched in the signed expression, and carries true shortened masses. The separate middle term uses the original selector and original K0, M, eta and direct predicates, with per-label comparison when sigma depends on equality labels.
limitations: The assertion is scoped to the stated smooth multiplier across the total partner sum. It does not extend to one sharp original frequency window, to h0-dependent v or a sum over arbitrary v, or to the unbalanced intermediate-divisor gap.
